topologyMeasurements.caveat: Focused analytical in-memory proposal only, not a final historical-display gate. Pre-existing source/modern-neighbor overlap is retained exactly, not repaired. Aggregate coast delta area is not a territorial event or positional-accuracy claim.

historicalCaveats: Retain 1956-01-01..2011-07-08 and pre-secession southern territory. Existing source is a medium-certainty modern SDN+SDS successor union, not a period-surveyed border.
The post-2011 approved donor is a low-certainty composite modern outline; its 2011 start is a political event date, not proof that every donor coordinate existed then.
Keep Egypt/Halaib/Bir Tawil political attribution, old 22nd-parallel junction and source boundary untouched. Do not resolve disputed control histories with this coast refresh.

Retain the original southern coast/Eritrea junction. Eritrea independence is 1993-05-24 in existing entity metadata; before that the adjacent entity history differs, but the coast-only delta avoids both modern ERI and ETH.
Abyei and Sudan/South Sudan border or post-2011 conflict chronology are outside scope.
No period-specific evidence of Port Sudan/Suakin shoreline or reclamation was newly checked. Describe this as provisional modern display-coast reuse, not historically verified geometry.
